sprint_goal: The last 23 Medium bugs are fixed and commits test on the gate host; each fix's test fails without it

seats.achievable: partial - all 23 Medium bugs are groomed to a Fixed path and US1190 and US1191 deliver the gate-host clause, but the batch cannot show every fix's test fails without it: BG1581 AC3 and BG1678 AC1 already pass at HEAD, BG1538, BG1540 AC3 and BG1548 AC3 have no executable proof, and BG0949, BG0957 and BG0986 state no pre-fix failure.
seats.done_means: Serves O1 and O5 (Maya Okafor goals 1 and 5; Rowan Achterberg goal 1): all 23 Medium bugs reach Fixed with their Verify lines passing, US1190 and US1191 are Done so a commit's selected suites run on sdlc.gateHost, and for each fix its named test is seen red on the pre-fix tree and green after.
seats.one_increment: yes - the Medium-bug sweep is the single increment, with US1190 and US1191 as the enabling first step (remote-gate staged-tree mode, then the commit-msg call) and BG1731 and BG1732 as two Low flake fixes in the same test-infra lane; the units sharing files (BG0949 BG1063 BG1569 on sdlc_md.py; BG1310 BG1514 BG1731 US1190 on remote-gate or conftest; BG1574 US1191 on commit-msg) must be serialised, not an obstacle to one increment.
seats.note: Count check: the 25 bugs in the batch less BG1731 and BG1732 (Low) are 23 Medium; BG1723 (Medium, BG0967's carry, manual Verify lines) stays open until BG0967 is Fixed, so the 0-Medium bar of D0560 needs it closed in the same run. Weak failing-first coverage: (1) BG1581 AC3 verify test_the_gate_fixture_survives_an_importers_teardown already exists and PASSES at HEAD (measured, 1 passed), so it cannot fail without the fix; (2) BG1678 AC1 `reconcile.py detect | grep drift_items=0` is already true at HEAD (measured drift_items=0) and only reddens once BG1569 lands, so it must land in the same commit as BG1569 or gate red appears between lanes, and it is not listed in a shared-file cluster with BG1569; its AC2 `grep -q BG1678 decisions.md` is satisfied by any mention of the id, a tautology; (3) BG1538 AC1-3 are manual reads with no oracle; (4) BG1540 AC3 and BG1548 AC3 carry no Verify line at all; (5) BG0949, BG0957 and BG0986 criteria state no 'Fails on' and use -k selectors, so the red-before check must be done by hand (apply mutant, watch fail, LC-001). BG1569 (5 pts, 13 Affects incl. readiness.py and handoff.py) and BG1574 (5 pts, 7 files, new commit-msg lane) look tight for their criteria. US1191's tests use stubs for remote-gate, so 'commits test on the gate host' is proven by fixtures only, never a real ssh round trip; and US1190 and US1191 are Draft with Delivers CR0663 while the goal names only bugs. Test census (LC-023): many new test modules, run tools/tests/test_test_census.py in each self-check.

clauses.The last 23 Medium bugs are fixed and co: partial - US1190 (remote-gate staged-tree mode, exits 0/1/3/4/2, serialised host runs) and US1191 (commit-msg sends the selection to the host, falls back local, SDLC_GATE_LOCAL=1) deliver 'commits test on the gate host', and the 23 Medium bugs are each groomed with Verify lines. Missing: no criterion exercises a real ssh transport to the gate host (fixtures stand in), and BG1538, BG1540 AC3 and BG1548 AC3 have no executable proof of fixed.
clauses.each fix's test fails without it: partial - most criteria name a fails-on and a concrete test (BG1731, BG1574, BG1455, BG1373, BG1570, BG1063, BG1407, BG1514, BG1272, BG1027 among them). Not delivered for: BG1581 AC3 (test already passes at HEAD), BG1678 AC1 (already green at HEAD; red only after BG1569), BG1678 AC2 (tautological grep), BG1538 (manual only), BG1540 AC3 and BG1548 AC3 (no Verify), and BG0949 BG0957 BG0986 (no stated pre-fix failure; run each test against HEAD first).

seats.achievable: partial - the 27 units cover the goal in scope: the 23 Medium bugs (BG1514, BG1027, BG1272, BG1574, BG1101, BG1511, BG0957, BG1256, BG1310, BG1581, BG1407, BG1569, BG1678, BG0949, BG0986, BG1455, BG1540, BG1373, BG1570, BG1538, BG1548, BG1063, BG0967) plus US1190/US1191 for the gate-host clause and two Low bugs (BG1731, BG1732). Three Medium units cannot meet 'each fix's test fails without it' as written (BG1538, BG1678, BG1548 AC3), and the shared-file clusters need serialising.
seats.done_means: All 23 Medium bugs are Fixed, each with an executable criterion run red on the pre-fix tree and green after it, and a commit's selected test modules judged on sdlc.gateHost through US1190's remote-gate staged-tree mode and US1191's commit-msg call, with a local fallback. It serves O1 and O5 (Maya Okafor goal 5, Abena Osei goal 6) and Rowan Achterberg's goal 1.
seats.one_increment: yes - one theme, 'make the push and commit gates trustworthy': US1190/US1191 (commit suites on the host), test-isolation and flake fixes (BG1101, BG1511, BG1732, BG1514, BG1310, BG1256, BG1581, BG1407, BG0957), hook fixes (BG1027, BG1272, BG1574) and corpus/script fixes. The RFC, filer and docs units (BG1569, BG1678, BG0967, BG1548, BG1538, BG1063) are the loose edge but are all open Mediums, which is the goal's own definition of the set.
seats.note: 1) BG1538 (all three criteria are 'manual ... no test can pin it'), BG1678 AC2 (grep -q BG1678 passes if the id is mentioned anywhere in decisions.md) and BG1548 AC3 (no Verify line) cannot fail without their fix; give each a failing check (e.g. a reconcile or planner readiness assertion for BG1538 AC3, a decisions.md row-shape check for BG1678) or accept them as paperwork explicitly. 2) BG1514 AC1/AC2 are timing tests; 'fails without it' needs the mutant to be the old fixed window run under an injected delay, else the test is green on both trees (LC-001: apply the mutant and watch it go red). 3) Shared-file clusters (BG0949/BG1063/BG1569 on sdlc_md.py; BG1310/BG1514/BG1731/US1190 on remote-gate.sh or the runners; BG1574/US1191 on .githooks/commit-msg) must be serialised, with US1190 then US1191 first. BG1678 must land in the same commit as BG1569 (its AC1 needs drift_items=0). 4) US1191 is risk-class high: brief its second seat as soon as the qa seat's first APPROVE lands (LC-024). 5) Points look low for BG0967 (3 for a four-criterion matrix across four creators, a guard and a prose case, with three rejected rounds behind it) and BG1063 (3 for four criteria over about eight files plus a PRD refresh); expect a split or carry. BG1723 closes with BG0967 and is not in the 27. 6) Any new test module needs tools/tests/test_test_census.py in the builder's self-check (LC-023). 7) The clause 'commits test on the gate host' is delivered by US1190/US1191 but the run's own commits only exercise it if the stories land first and sdlc.gateHost is set.

clauses.The last 23 Medium bugs are fixed and co: partial - the 23 Mediums are each a unit in the batch; the gate-host half is delivered by US1190 (remote-gate staged-tree mode, exits 0/1/2/3/4, serialised, no leaked tree) and US1191 (commit-msg sends the selection to the host and falls back locally on 3/4, honours SDLC_GATE_LOCAL=1, CONTRIBUTING updated). Missing: nothing asserts the run's own commits actually went to the host, BG1538/BG1678 are paperwork, and US1190 and US1191 must land before the other units for any later commit to use it.
clauses.each fix's test fails without it: partial - most criteria name a pytest Verify and an 'Fails on: HEAD' clause (BG1574, BG1101, BG1063, BG1570, BG1569, BG1027, BG1272, BG1511, BG1256, BG1310, US1190, US1191), so the red-before-fix check is real. Gaps: BG1538 (manual only), BG1678 AC2 (a grep that passes on any mention), BG1548 AC3 (no Verify), BG1514 AC1/AC2 (timing tests that may pass unfixed unless a delay is injected), BG0949 (-k selectors that must be shown to select the named tests), and the doc units BG1063 AC2 and BG1569 AC3, which rest on a reading test that needs a mutant run.

seats.achievable: yes - the 23 Medium bugs (BG0949 BG0957 BG0986 BG1027 BG1063 BG1101 BG1256 BG1272 BG1310 BG1373 BG1407 BG1455 BG1511 BG1514 BG1538 BG1540 BG1548 BG1569 BG1570 BG1574 BG1581 BG1678 BG0967) are all in the batch and each carries a Verify line; US1190 and US1191 deliver 'commits test on the gate host'. The risk is size and order, not coverage: BG1574 (5), BG1569 (5) and US1190 (5) are the big units, and BG1678 cannot close until BG1569 lands.
seats.done_means: Serves Rowan Achterberg End goal 1 (a push is judged against exactly the commit pushed in about ten minutes on a gate host) and End goal 4 (main never left red and unread), and the process-stays-small outcome O5 (a repeated failure fixed in the code path): every Medium bug open at plan time is Fixed, BG1723 closes with BG0967, and a commit's selected suites run on the gate host with a local fallback.
seats.one_increment: yes - one theme, a green and trustworthy gate: the gate-host work (US1190, US1191, BG1514, BG1731), the flaky or racy tests that refuse pushes (BG1101, BG1511, BG1732, BG0957, BG1256, BG1310, BG1581, BG1407) and the Medium backlog clear-out under the 6.5 bar. The RFC lane (BG1569, BG1678, BG1548) and the filer redesign (BG0967) are the least related but are Mediums the goal names.
seats.note: 1. Goal names no persona; trace it to Rowan End goals 1 and 4 and O5. 2. BG1538 has three manual 'read the records' Verify lines, and BG1678 AC2 is only grep -q BG1678 decisions.md, which passes on any mention; neither can fail without its fix, so they are paperwork, not tests (acceptable if the goal wording is read as 'each code fix'). 3. BG0957, BG0949 and BG0986 state no 'Fails on' line, so whether their tests go red without the fix is unstated; BG1027 has one for three criteria. 4. BG1731 (Low) and BG1732 (Low) are in the batch to unblock the push gate, not Mediums; sound, but they take points from the goal's own count (no clause names them). 5. US1190/US1191 are still Draft and the story gate refuses Done unless ACs pass; both are Points 5 and 3 for a staged-tree remote run with serialisation and cleanup, which looks tight at 5. 6. BG0967 at 3 points under D0610 changes user-visible filer behaviour (unfenced '#' lines are no longer rewritten): the operator should read that as a decided cost to Steps authors. 7. Shared-file clusters (BG0949/BG1063/BG1569 in sdlc_md.py; BG1310/BG1514/BG1731/US1190; BG1574/US1191) must be serialised.

clauses.The last 23 Medium bugs are fixed and co: yes - all 23 Medium bugs are named units (see achievable); 'commits test on the gate host' is delivered by US1190 (remote-gate.sh judges a staged tree's selected modules on the host, refusing with output relayed, unreachable host not a verdict) and US1191 (commit-msg hook sends suites to the named host, falls back locally, CONTRIBUTING updated), supported by BG1514 and BG1731 for the release lane. Missing: nothing in the units; BG1723 closes only when BG0967 is Fixed, so it is a dependent, not a 24th unit.
clauses.each fix's test fails without it: partial - most units state 'Fails on' and pytest Verify lines (US1190, US1191, BG1101 and BG1272 among them). Gaps: BG1538 is all manual reads and BG1678 AC2 is a bare grep, so neither can fail without its fix; BG0957, BG0949 and BG0986 have no 'Fails on' sentence; BG1027 has one for three criteria. The sprint needs a per-unit mutation or revert check (critic self-check) to make the clause true for those.
